content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not an authorization, information, coding, or medical-necessity issue, so retro-authorization, records submission, correction, and a necessity appeal do not properly address it. A peer-to-peer has already been requested, and repeating submission risks an avoidable duplicate denial; the balance also cannot properly be shifted to the patient. Human review is needed to examine the paid bundled service and determine whether payer processing or a modifier-specific exception supports further action."}
